method.signal_timing: signal at close t; forward return enters at close t+1
method.score: z(MOVE) - z(VIX) + z(20d change in 10Y yield) + z(20d oil return)
method.main_event: score >= rolling prior-3y 90th percentile AND VIX <= 20
method.strict_event: MOVE >= prior-1y p80, VIX<=20, 20d 10Y change>=+0.15pp, oil 20d return>0
method.null: same-size random samples from de-clustered VIX<=20 non-event dates
method.edge_candidate_gate: main event, horizon 20/60, n>=10, BH q<=0.05, abs excess mean>=1%
